name: wildcard-excluded-far-inner-invalid
description: A deep wildcard SAN whose every expansion is inside an excluded subtree must be rejected: *.bar.foo.example.com expands only to names under the excluded foo.example.com.
references: Go name_constraints_test "subdomain excluded constraints preclude far inner wildcard names"
notes: RFC 5280 does not define wildcard SAN semantics; this targets Go's application DNS-ID name-constraint behavior.
